newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs bear negative bias, long-end weakest in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: JGBs bear negative bias, long-end weakest in Tokyo.

text.p: The cash JGBs had a negative bias by late trading on Wednesday with the long-end hardest hit by portfolio reshuffling of institutional investors, traders said.
"The long-end (of the JGBs) was hurt by persistent offers by institutional investors who were shortening the average portfolio life," said a city bank trader.

The key March JGB futures contract ended at 125.46, down from 125.62 on Tuesday. Earlier, March was driven up to 125.87 by speculation, later proved wrong, that last-minute buying in cash JGBs would emerge. Today is the last trading day for cash bond deliveries within this year.
